notes.title: Hotfix 1.64
notes.content:
Hello again!

After sitting on this one for a while, I'm deciding to change the qualification time on 5-5 from 6.98 to a more lenient 7.08.

It's quite possible that with the underlying engine update, I might have included minor changes in the physics and timing that make it just a little bit too difficult to achieve that time compared to the original version of the game. It is still possible to hit the 6.98 but can involve hacks and tricks that I don't intend players to have to put up with.

I know this can be quite unfair to old players who put in the hard work for that level before, so my apologies to anyone who might feel this is not right 🙏. But the game is fundamentally different now and it's been almost a decade since the release, so I think it's okay to make this small change to help reduce the suffering for new players who might be struggling a bit too much with this level.

The new time is not that much easier to hit, so I think this change keeps in the spirit of World 5 being obtusely difficult as I originally intended it to be.

I hope that with this update, your time with the game is smoother and more lovely.

Infinite Bliss ✨

notes.title: Hotfix 1.63
notes.content:
Hello hello!

Quick update that addresses the Restart key not being rebindable in the controls menu.

Hot tip : you can change the sensitivity options using the Tab and Tilde (~) keys for faster scrolling. The same keys that allow level scrolling in-game.

Infinite Bliss ✨

notes.title: Hotfix 1.62
notes.content:
Hello!

This update adds a Developer Console to the game which can be accessed from the Main Menu.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6382250/83ab8e7538422de044019422bfbed3565f34dadb.png

Hit Shift + F1 to enable the console. For now, the following commands are available for use.

1) "unlock" - a soft unlock that opens all levels in the main menu. This command doesn't affect your saved progress.

2) "reset_secrets" - resets all secrets. ⚠️ This will remove your progress from the save file. ⚠️ Achievements will not be affected.

All commands need to be prefixed with "!!" to work. I'll add some more functions in updates to follow.

First Lovely Planet update to ship from Japan! 🎌

Infinite Bliss ✨

The new input system also finally fixes the issue where you had to leave and press the arrow keys again before starting a new level!

Hope you're enjoying the game! Up next, some QoL features for speedrunners.

notes.title: Update 1.5
notes.content:
It's been a while!

Hello there fellow Lovelies 💖

Hope you're all doing well! It's been eight years since Lovely Planet was first released and it almost feels like a lifetime ago. I've been on and off with sequels and spinoffs of the original game which some of you might have heard of over the years. I've not been actively supporting older titles for a multitude of reasons, mostly because of my interest in exploring new gameplay and ideas. I want to apologize for being absent from the discussion board and a big thanks to all the community members who have provided support for everyone 🙏

The other reasons range from lazy excuses to formidable technical hurdles that I created for myself unknowingly. With free time on my hands again and a sudden mysterious drive that's bringing me back to working on Lovely Planet 🤨, I've crossed one very big technical hurdle with surprisingly little effort. I won't bore you with the technical details, but the game is now ported over to a newer version of the underlying engine. The biggest change - we're supporting modern 64-bit macOS! And now that the game is better positioned for potential future updates, I'll try to touch it up when I get more time. The Linux build will be a while longer, more updates on that soon.

Hope you are enjoying the game! If you're looking for a fresh challenge and a little bit more variety in gameplay, I'd suggest giving Lovely Planet Remix a look see! It's got a demo too if you'd like to try it first!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1604780

Other than that, I don't have any specifics about what kind of updates we're going to see for Lovely Planet going forward. I'll be taking the winter off to see if I can find some inspiration, maybe I'll prototype a bit. A new title? Ahhh, the good ol' days! Love making videogames!

See you on the leaderboards 💪

Infinite Bliss  ✨

- Vidhvat 🙏

notes.title: Lovely Planet Remix Out November 12
notes.content:
Hello Friends!

It's been a while. How are you doing? Hope you're enjoying Lovely Planet and all the different games in the series. Before we proceed, I just want to take this moment to thank you - thank you for playing Lovely Planet, for sharing the game with your friends and trying out the sequels. I love making these games and it wouldn't have been possible without your love and support! So thanks a lot 🙏

After another year of burning the midnight oil in front of my computer screen, I'm super excited to share with you the next installment in the series.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1604780
[previewyoutube=soaR4dBmwEs;full][/previewyoutube]

Lovely Planet is back, this time a buffet of unique shooter games! Official Site

Master the Jelly Gun, double jump in the mountains, quickstep with a pistol in the tunnels or stick to the classic gun ballet you know and love!

Play it your way, compete on the leaderboards and watch replays to learn new tricks!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6382250/1283ec58e7aaa5c2041f5213c95dce9cb2f2ca26.gif


 Choose your own shooter! 14 playlists, 6 different game types
 Dedicated Leaderboards with Replays
 Speedrun playlists with limited lives in Arcade Mode
 150 Levels with Secrets & Achievements
 Out November 12 on Steam for Win & Mac

Wishlist on Steam and join the Discord!

As always, the game is not a direct sequel to the original and changes a lot of things which might come to some as an unexpected surprise. Here's a quick disclaimer about what to expect from the new game for fans of the original.

Lovely Planet Remix extends the original game with a variety of drastic variations that impose restrictions like no mid-air control, no jumping, slower movement & bullet drop among others in the vein of older retro shooters with non-standard control schemes, some of which are designed intentionally to be unwieldy, cumbersome and annoying to play by modern standards. Please try the demo to sample the different styles before purchasing the game.

Thank you and wishing everyone a happy holiday season!

Cheers

notes.title: PCGamer gives Lovely Planet 82/100
notes.content:
http://media.pcgamer.com/files/2014/07/Lovely-Planet1-610x343.jpg

"A great, merciless speedrunning platformer and twitch shooter" - 82/100, PCGamer

WOO! 

Hi everyone. The first reviews are coming in and people seem to be liking it. Thanks everyone for the support! 

Meanwhile I'm compiling an FAQ for the game, and some of the most asked questions so far:

Q - How much will the game cost?
A - It will launch at $5.99, with the same price across UK and EUR based on today's conversion rate

Q - How do you get each of the stars?
Anaswer....
Blue Star - Finish the level
Green Star - Finish the level under the 'Q' qualification time

The FAQ thread is unlocked so go ahead and ask questions there
Yellow Star - Finish the level with 100% accuracy (no wasted bullets)
